name: Enchantment Mods
description: Six new enchantments. Weapons (swords, spears, maces): Frost Aspect freezes, Poison Aspect poisons and Weakening Touch weakens the target, and Strength Surge adds 15% damage per level while you are below half health. Armor: Protection Surge cuts damage by 6% per level while you are below half health, and Knockback Resistance cuts knockback by 8% per level. Find the books in trial vaults, ominous vaults, trial chamber chests, stronghold libraries and mansions, buy them from expert and master librarians, or roll them at the enchanting table. Hold a book and tap an anvil to apply it. Only one aspect per item, Fire Aspect included.

name: Armor & Effects HUD
description: Shows your armor and off-hand item with real item icons (glinting when enchanted) and current durability, plus every potion effect with its icon and time remaining, on the left side of the screen. When you hit a player or mob, the damage it actually took (after armor and effects) floats up above it.
